name: Member's Mark 100% Pure Liquid Egg Whites (6 x 16 oz Cartons)
whyItWorks: Pure pasteurized egg whites offer 100% bioavailable protein with zero fat, zero cholesterol, zero lactose, and zero fiber. It is arguably the easiest protein for a severely inflamed bowel to absorb.
